mustFixFindings.why: Three injuries, all byte-verifiable on the subject alone. (1) $.doesNot is the artifact's standing negative-scope recital - the field a later recording or provenance audit reads to learn what this successor did not do. Recording this candidate would enter into the register lineage a statement that g21 leftover-join.v16 landed no finding, standing beside a findingDisposition saying it landed three. (2) The contradiction is with $.basedOn.predecessorV15.role's 'Findings land at g21 leftover-join.v16.' - the one sentence that carries the frozen g21 leftover-join.v15 REJECT forward. Read against $.doesNot[43], the artifact both accepts and denies the transfer, so the bytes do not say where G21LJ-V15-M1, G21LJ-V15-SF1, and the unlabeled Codex MUST-FIX landed. (3) The clause denies precisely the act this cycle exists to perform, which is the one claim a Stage A review of a landing successor must be able to read off the bytes.
mustFixFindings.provenance: Inherited-stale clause, not a fresh error. $.doesNot in this lineage is append-only: each successor appends its turn-specific denials at the tail. The clause entered at g21 leftover-join.v13 as the final entry (index 43 of 44), where it was true - v13 remasured dual-ACCEPT v12 and landed nothing. It was carried verbatim at the same index 43 through v14 and v15, both also pure remeasurements landing nothing, both dual ACCEPT 0/0 and single-REJECT-on-other-grounds respectively. v16 is the first version in this lineage to both land findings and carry the clause. Corpus-wide measurement: exactly 14 artifacts under docs/coop/artifacts/ carry a 'land or re-land' doesNot clause; 13 of them have zero current-turn landings in findingDisposition, and g21 leftover-join.v16 has three. Independently, 68 leftover-join artifacts declare a landing act (purpose beginning 'Land'); 67 carry no such clause and g21 leftover-join.v16 is the sole exception. In this lineage specifically, every prior landing successor - v4, v6, v7, v9, v11 - carries no such clause. In the g19 lineage the clause appears once at v5 and is gone by v6, confirming it is a turn-specific statement rather than a lineage-standing law.
mustFixFindings.narrowReadingRefuted: A narrower reading was tested and refuted: that 'land or re-land' might be scoped to the $.appliesFindingsOf historical channel, so that a successor landing only through findingDisposition could carry it consistently. If that reading were operative, some clause-carrier would land current-turn findings through findingDisposition. None does. All 13 other clause-carriers return zero matches for a current-turn 'Landed:' or 'Landed with' disposition; the subject returns three.
mustFixFindings.remedy: Delete $.doesNot[43] 'Does not land or re-land any finding.', matching every prior landing successor in this lineage (g21 leftover-join.v4, v6, v7, v9, v11) and every one of the other 67 landing leftover-joins in the corpus. rejectionStatement: g21 leftover-join.v16 lands all three frozen g21 leftover-join.v15 findings correctly and its delta is otherwise clean and surgical: 85 of 85 path/digest pairs, 97 of 97 recorded input digests, 15 of 15 commit pins, and 54 of 54 cited review verdicts all re-resolve true against live bytes. It is rejected on one defect it introduced by inheritance rather than by edit. $.doesNot[43] 'Does not land or re-land any finding.' entered this lineage at g21 leftover-join.v13 as a true statement about a pure remeasurement and was carried unexamined at the same index through v14 and v15, which were also pure remeasurements. v16 is the first version in this lineage to land findings while still carrying it, and the clause is now false of its own artifact - contradicted by $.purpose, by $.basedOn.predecessorV15.role's 'Findings land at g21 leftover-join.v16.', and by three 'Landed' entries in $.findingDisposition. Across the whole corpus, 67 of 68 landing leftover-joins carry no such clause and 13 of 14 clause-carriers land nothing; g21 leftover-join.v16 is the sole artifact on the wrong side of both counts. Deleting the one array element repairs it; nothing else depends on it.
